thread:
Aisha B: Morning! Just unboxed my workstation. Two small issues: the HDMI cable that shipped with the monitor is bent near the connector, and my company headset mic isn't being detected in Zoom. Wifi is fine. Who to ping?
IT Support: Hey Aisha, welcome! Sorry about that. Can you try swapping the HDMI cable with another one temporarily to confirm it's the cable and not the monitor port? For the headset, is it USB-A or USB-C? Also have you run the audio setup in Zoom (Settings -> Audio)?
Aisha B: It's USB-C headset. Zoom setup doesn't show mic input. On macOS under System Preferences -> Sound I also don't see the headset as an input device.
IT Support: Ok that points to driver/OS recognition. Can you open Terminal and run `system_profiler SPUSBDataType` and paste the short block that includes the headset (if present)? If it's not listed, the dongle or cable might be faulty.
Aisha B: Ran it, headset doesn't show up. HDMI cable swap fixed display so that's just the cable.
IT Support: Thanks. We'll ship a replacement USB-C headset and an HDMI cable. Created ticket IT-219002. Shipping ETA 2 business days.
Noah R: @Aisha B welcome! If you need to jump on a quick call to test audio before the replacement arrives, I can remote in and help.
Aisha B: That'd be great, thanks Noah. Also, any docs about getting keys/access for the office?
IT Support: Office badge access is handled by People Ops. I can cc them on the shipment email or you can file a People Ops access request: https://intranet.redwood/people-ops/access-request.
DevEx Bot: Heads up: onboarding office tour at 10:30am in the lobby.
Aisha B: Thanks all, appreciate the quick triage!
IT Support: Closing thread; updates will be posted to IT-219002 when items ship.
